{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load and deduplicate data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')
data = data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Replace sentinel values
data['biomarker_baseline'] = data['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Compute change
data['biomarker_change'] = data['biomarker_final'] - data['biomarker_baseline']

# Use only valid data (non-missing baseline and final)
valid_data = data.dropna(subset=['biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final'])

# Stratify by severity and compute mean biomarker change within each severity level
stratified_change = valid_data.groupby(['severity', 'arm'])['biomarker_change'].mean().unstack(level='arm')
print("Mean biomarker change by severity and arm:")
print(stratified_change)

# Compute difference in change within each severity stratum
stratified_diff = stratified_change['treatment'] - stratified_change['control']
print("\nDifference in biomarker change (treatment - control) by severity:")
print(stratified_diff)

# Compute response rates within each severity level
stratified_response = valid_data.groupby(['severity', 'arm'])['responded'].mean().unstack(level='arm')
print("\nResponse rate by severity and arm:")
print(stratified_response)

# Compute difference in response rate within each severity stratum
stratified_response_diff = stratified_response['treatment'] - stratified_response['control']
print("\nDifference in response rate (treatment - control) by severity:")
print(stratified_response_diff)"}
